title.zh-CN: 发热约1个月伴肝脾肿大 · 7岁1个月男孩
title.en: About a month of fever with an enlarged liver and spleen · boy aged 7 years 1 month

summary.zh-CN: 7岁男孩发烧一个来月，按感冒治疗不见好，医生发现他肝脾肿大，收入病房进一步检查。
summary.en: A 7-year-old boy with about a month of fever that treatment for a cold has not settled, and an enlarged liver and spleen, is admitted for investigation.

notes.zh-CN: 依据一篇已发表的单例报告改写。患者事实沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容：年龄、发热经过与当地治疗、发热初期即发现的肝脾肿大、无同胞及无类似家族史、入院血常规与铁蛋白、甘油三酯、纤维蛋白原、骨髓噬血细胞、血EB病毒DNA、NK细胞及穿孔素和颗粒酶B、基因报告、治疗后缓解又再活动、全相合非血缘移植、移植后HHV-6阳性腹泻及临床Ⅲ度肠道GVHD、9个月时的嵌合与转归、移植后血液基因检测反映供者造血；尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、日历日期和身份细节已去除，时间以相对时间表示。陪同家属的具体身份、对话、阶段、决策、处置选项、评分、教学要点和医护人物是教学设计；没有记录的内容（生命体征、体重身高、肝功能、可溶性CD25、NK细胞活性、脑脊液、骨髓其余描述、所用方案和剂量、预处理与供者细节、GVHD预防和治疗）保持未知。保留的不一致与含糊之处：发热被分别写作“间断”“反复”和“持续”；中性粒细胞“0.84”未注明单位；EB病毒DNA拷贝数未注明体积；NK细胞1.9%未注明分母；SH2D1A变异命名不清；HHV-6阳性腹泻与肠道GVHD是同时还是先后出现未说明；“9个月”的起点未说明；报告标题称MUNC13-4突变家族性HLH，而基因记录只有一个UNC13D杂合变异。
notes.en: Adapted from one published case report. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0: age, the fever and its treatment elsewhere, the enlarged liver and spleen found early in the illness, no siblings and no similar family history, the admission blood count with ferritin, triglycerides and fibrinogen, marrow haemophagocytes, blood EBV DNA, NK cells with perforin and granzyme B, the gene report, remission and then renewed activity on treatment, the fully matched unrelated transplant, HHV-6-positive diarrhoea and clinical grade III intestinal GVHD after it, chimerism and outcome at 9 months, and post-transplant blood genotyping reflecting donor haematopoiesis; they have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed, and times are relative. Which relative accompanies him, the dialogue, phases, decisions, management options, scoring, teaching points and staff are teaching design; what the case does not record (vital signs, weight and height, liver tests, soluble CD25, NK-cell activity, CSF, the rest of the marrow description, the regimen and doses, conditioning and donor details, GVHD prophylaxis and treatment) stays unknown. Inconsistencies and ambiguities kept: the fever is called intermittent, recurrent and persistent; the neutrophil figure 0.84 has no unit; the EBV DNA copies have no volume; NK cells 1.9 % has no denominator; the SH2D1A notation is unclear; whether the HHV-6-positive diarrhoea and the intestinal GVHD were simultaneous or sequential is not stated; the starting point of “9 months” is not stated; the report's title names MUNC13-4-mutated familial HLH while the genetic record shows one heterozygous UNC13D variant.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对长期发热伴脾大和血细胞减少的儿童，按HLH-2004标准（国际组织细胞协会，2007）识别噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增生症——本例脾大、血常规、甘油三酯和纤维蛋白原、铁蛋白和骨髓已满足8条中的5条——并说明EB病毒只是诱因，不能排除原发性（遗传性）HLH。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in a child with prolonged fever, splenomegaly and cytopenias by the HLH-2004 criteria (Histiocyte Society, 2007) — five of eight here from the enlarged spleen, the blood count, triglycerides with fibrinogen, ferritin and the marrow — and explain why an EBV trigger does not exclude a primary (genetic) form.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在EB病毒相关HLH确诊后立即开始HLH-94诱导（地塞米松10 mg/m²/天、依托泊苷150 mg/m²每周2次；国际组织细胞协会2018共识），不等基因结果，也不用抗病毒药代替（Imashuku 2001；儿童EB病毒感染相关疾病专家共识2021）。
learningOutcomes.en: Start HLH-94 induction (dexamethasone 10 mg/m²/day and etoposide 150 mg/m² twice weekly; Histiocyte Society consensus 2018) as soon as EBV-associated HLH is diagnosed, without waiting for genetic results and without substituting antivirals (Imashuku 2001; Chinese consensus on EBV-related disease in children 2021).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按合子状态和遗传方式解读基因报告：单个UNC13D杂合变异不能确立常染色体隐性的FHL3（Munc13-4的功能用CD107a脱颗粒试验检测）；SH2D1A半合子变异须按HGVS规范重新书写、按ACMG/AMP 2015分类，并有SAP蛋白表达支持（NACHO 2019），才能诊断X连锁淋巴组织增生症1型。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret a gene report by zygosity and inheritance: one heterozygous UNC13D variant does not establish autosomal recessive FHL3 (Munc13-4 function is tested by CD107a degranulation), and a hemizygous SH2D1A variant must be written in HGVS, classified under ACMG/AMP 2015 and supported by SAP protein expression (NACHO 2019) before it means XLP1.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: HLH在诱导治疗后再活动时，无论基因结果如何都转诊行异基因造血干细胞移植（HLH-2004），没有同胞供者时启动非血缘供者检索。
learningOutcomes.en: Refer for allogeneic haematopoietic stem cell transplantation when HLH reactivates after induction, whatever the genetic result (HLH-2004), and start an unrelated-donor search when there is no sibling donor.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对移植后腹泻同时评估急性GVHD和感染，在排查感染的同时对Ⅱ–Ⅳ度肠道GVHD开始甲泼尼龙2 mg/kg/天（EBMT 2024；HHV-6按ECIL-7 2019）。
learningOutcomes.en: Assess diarrhoea after transplantation for acute GVHD and infection in parallel, and start methylprednisolone 2 mg/kg/day for grade II–IV gut GVHD while infection is investigated (EBMT 2024; HHV-6 per ECIL-7 2019).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明为什么移植后的血液基因型代表供者，胚系检测改用移植前保存的DNA或培养的皮肤成纤维细胞，并安排遗传咨询和父母检测。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why post-transplant blood reflects the donor's genotype, use stored pre-transplant DNA or cultured skin fibroblasts for germline testing, and plan genetic counselling with testing of both parents.

chiefComplaint.en: Fevers on and off for about a month

triageNote.zh-CN: 7岁1个月男孩，由家属陪同入院：间断发热约1个月，当地按上呼吸道感染治疗效果差；发热初期即发现肝脾肿大。
triageNote.en: Boy aged 7 years 1 month, admitted with a relative: intermittent fever for about a month, little better on treatment for an upper respiratory infection elsewhere; an enlarged liver and spleen were found early in the illness.

personality.zh-CN: 7岁的男孩，断断续续发烧一个来月，住院检查；家属陪着他，大多数问题由家属回答。
personality.en: A 7-year-old boy who has had fevers on and off for about a month and is in hospital for tests; his relative is with him and answers most questions.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 孩子话很少，只用短句说自己老发烧；家属用日常口语回答，不用医学术语，记不清的就直说记不清。
speechStyle.en: The boy says very little, in short sentences, only that he keeps getting fevers; his relative answers in everyday words without medical terms and says so when they cannot remember something.

openingLine.zh-CN: （孩子）我老是发烧，烧了一个来月了。
openingLine.en: (The boy) I keep getting fevers — it's been about a month.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：7岁男孩，家属陪着。孩子只说自己老发烧，其余问题由家属回答。不要表演本病例没有给出的症状（疼痛、皮疹、出血、抽搐、嗜睡、黄疸都不要演）。家属着急但配合，只讲自己知道或听医生说过的事；化验结果和诊断由医生来说。后面阶段的变化（治疗后好转又再活动、移植、移植后腹泻）只在病例进入那个阶段后才说，之前不要提；不知道的事就直说不知道，不要编。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: a 7-year-old boy with his relative. The boy says only that he keeps getting fevers; his relative answers everything else. Do not act out symptoms the case does not give (no pain, rash, bleeding, fits, drowsiness or jaundice). The relative is worried but cooperative and says only what they know or have heard from the doctors; results and the diagnosis are for the doctors. Later changes (better on treatment and then flaring again, the transplant, diarrhoea after it) are mentioned only once the case reaches that phase, never before; whatever they do not know they say so plainly and never invent.

persona.zh-CN: 孩子的近亲属，陪他住院；具体是哪位亲属不清楚，不要另加设定。着急、心疼孩子，但愿意配合；用日常口语回答，只讲自己知道或听医生说过的事；记不清的数字和药名就直说，不替医生下结论。
persona.en: A close relative staying with him in hospital; which relative is not known, so add nothing. Worried and protective but cooperative; answers in everyday words, saying only what they know or have heard from the doctors; admits forgetting numbers and drug names and draws no medical conclusions.

label.en: Admission: about a month of fever

description.zh-CN: 7岁男孩间断发热约1个月，当地按上呼吸道感染治疗效果差，发热初期即发现肝脾肿大，现收入病房。向陪同的家属了解病史，给他查体，开出检查，作出诊断并开始治疗。
description.en: A 7-year-old boy with about a month of intermittent fever, little better on treatment for an upper respiratory infection elsewhere and with an enlarged liver and spleen found early on, is admitted. Take the history from his relative, examine him, send the tests, make the diagnosis and start treatment.

description.en: After the first treatment the disease went into remission for a time, then showed signs of activity again (which signs, and when, is not recorded). The gene report can now be read (when it came back is not recorded).

description.en: He has had a haematopoietic stem cell transplant from a fully HLA-matched unrelated donor. After the transplant he developed diarrhoea.

name.zh-CN: 原报告记录的病程与转归

text.zh-CN: 报告标题的诊断：MUNC13-4突变所致家族性噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增多症。病程：按HLH方案治疗后缓解，此后又出现活动迹象，接受HLA全相合非血缘供者造血干细胞移植。移植后出现HHV-6阳性腹泻及临床Ⅲ度肠道GVHD，治疗后好转（所用治疗没有记录；两者是同时还是先后出现也没有记录）。9个月时供者完全嵌合、无病生存，无慢性GVHD。移植后的血液基因检测反映的是供者造血。没有记录：所用HLH方案和剂量、预处理方案、移植物来源和配型细节、GVHD预防与治疗用药、HHV-6标本和载量、父母基因检测和9个月以后的随访。
text.en: Diagnosis in the report's title: familial haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis with a MUNC13-4 mutation. Course: remission on an HLH protocol, then signs of renewed activity, then a haematopoietic stem cell transplant from a fully HLA-matched unrelated donor. After it, HHV-6-positive diarrhoea and clinical grade III intestinal GVHD improved with treatment (the treatment is not recorded, nor whether the two were simultaneous or sequential). At 9 months: complete donor chimerism and disease-free survival, without chronic GVHD. Blood genotyping after the transplant reflected the donor's haematopoiesis. Not recorded: the HLH regimen and doses, the conditioning, the graft source and HLA details, GVHD prophylaxis and treatment, the HHV-6 specimen and load, parental genetic testing or follow-up beyond 9 months.

name.en: Insert an IV cannula and take bloods

dose.zh-CN: 外周静脉留置针，同时留取血标本。
dose.en: A peripheral IV cannula, taking the blood samples at the same time.

response.zh-CN: 已建立静脉通路并留取血标本。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: IV access is in and the bloods are taken. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 地塞米松10 mg/m²/天（第1–2周），之后5、2.5、1.25 mg/m²/天分别用2周、2周和1周，第8周减停；口服或静脉；体表面积按实测身高和体重计算。
dose.en: Dexamethasone 10 mg/m²/day in weeks 1–2, then 5, 2.5 and 1.25 mg/m²/day for 2, 2 and 1 weeks, tapered off in week 8; by mouth or IV; body-surface area from his measured height and weight.

harm.zh-CN: HLH-94剂量的地塞米松本身就有抗白血病作用：骨髓结果出来之前就用，可能部分治疗并掩盖白血病或淋巴瘤，使诊断无法完成；NACHO（2019）提醒，针对HLH的治疗常会掩盖尚未诊断的恶性肿瘤，并把骨髓检查列为排除恶性肿瘤的必需检查。先看骨髓结果，再开始激素。
harm.en: Dexamethasone at the HLH-94 dose is itself an anti-leukaemic drug: started before the marrow result has been read, it can partly treat and hide a leukaemia or lymphoma and leave the diagnosis incomplete; NACHO (2019) warns that HLH-directed therapy often obscures an undiagnosed malignancy and counts the marrow as essential to rule one out. Read the marrow first, then start the steroid.

response.zh-CN: 地塞米松已开始（HLH-94方案的激素部分）。本病例没有记录所用的具体药物和剂量；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Dexamethasone started (the steroid of the HLH-94 regimen). This case does not record which drugs or doses were given; it does not simulate their effect.

dose.zh-CN: 依托泊苷150 mg/m²静脉滴注，第1–2周每周2次，第3–8周每周1次；体表面积按实测身高和体重计算，肾功能不全或严重骨髓抑制时由血液科调整剂量。
dose.en: Etoposide 150 mg/m² by IV infusion twice weekly in weeks 1–2, then weekly in weeks 3–8; body-surface area from his measured height and weight, the dose adjusted by the haematology team for renal impairment or severe myelosuppression.

harm.zh-CN: 骨髓检查完成之前就用依托泊苷，是在诊断尚未成立时上化疗，还可能掩盖白血病或淋巴瘤（NACHO 2019：针对HLH的治疗常会掩盖尚未诊断的恶性肿瘤）；应在骨髓和血液检查确立诊断之后再开始。
harm.en: Etoposide before the marrow has been examined means chemotherapy before the diagnosis is made, and it can mask a leukaemia or lymphoma (NACHO 2019: HLH-directed therapy often obscures an undiagnosed malignancy); it starts once the marrow and the bloods have established the diagnosis.

response.zh-CN: 依托泊苷已开始（HLH-94方案）。本病例没有记录所用的具体药物和剂量；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Etoposide started (the HLH-94 regimen). This case does not record which drugs or doses were given; it does not simulate their effect.

name.zh-CN: 复方磺胺甲噁唑预防耶氏肺孢子菌肺炎

dose.zh-CN: 口服，按体重及本地儿科方案给药，贯穿整个治疗期间。
dose.en: By mouth, weight-based per the local paediatric protocol, throughout the treatment.

response.zh-CN: 已开始预防用药。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Prophylaxis started. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 有出血或需要侵入性操作时，按实测血小板计数和纤维蛋白原输注血小板和冷沉淀，剂量按体重计算。
dose.en: Platelets and cryoprecipitate for bleeding or before an invasive procedure, guided by the measured platelet count and fibrinogen, dosed by weight.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录输血；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record any transfusion; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉更昔洛韦清除EB病毒
name.en: IV ganciclovir to clear the EBV

dose.zh-CN: 更昔洛韦按体重静脉滴注，目标是降低EB病毒载量。
dose.en: Ganciclovir IV, weight-based, aiming to bring the EBV load down.

harm.zh-CN: 抗病毒药对潜伏在淋巴细胞里的EB病毒作用很小，也控制不了过度炎症；用它代替HLH-94诱导只会推迟依托泊苷——EB病毒相关HLH确诊后4周内开始依托泊苷者长期生存率更高（Imashuku 2001）。2021年儿童EB病毒感染相关疾病专家共识也提醒避免过度抗病毒治疗。
harm.en: Antivirals do little against EBV latent in lymphocytes and do not control the hyperinflammation; given instead of HLH-94 induction they only delay etoposide, and in EBV-HLH long-term survival was better when etoposide began within four weeks of diagnosis (Imashuku 2001). The 2021 Chinese consensus on EBV-related disease in children also warns against antiviral overuse.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录抗病毒治疗；不模拟其效果。更昔洛韦治疗不了HLH，对潜伏在淋巴细胞内的EB病毒也基本无效，还会加重骨髓抑制。
response.en: This case does not record antiviral treatment; it does not simulate its effect. Ganciclovir does not treat HLH or the EBV latent in his lymphocytes, and it adds marrow suppression.

name.zh-CN: 按病毒感染出院，带退热药门诊复查
name.en: Discharge as a viral illness with antipyretics and a clinic review

dose.zh-CN: 出院回家，口服退热药，1周后门诊复查血常规。
dose.en: Home with antipyretics and a repeat blood count in clinic in a week.

harm.zh-CN: 治疗无效的一个月发热伴肝脾肿大需要住院检查，而不是门诊随访：要排除的包括危及生命的过度炎症、白血病和淋巴瘤，NACHO（2019）也提醒HLH常被延误诊断。下一步取决于血常规和骨髓结果。
harm.en: A month of fever with an enlarged liver and spleen that treatment has not settled needs inpatient work-up, not a clinic review: the causes to exclude include life-threatening hyperinflammation, leukaemia and lymphoma, and NACHO (2019) warns that HLH is often diagnosed late. The blood count and the marrow decide what comes next.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有这样处理（他已住院）；不模拟其后果。
response.en: This case did not do this (he was admitted); it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 与家属谈话并取得知情同意
name.en: Meet the family and take consent

dose.zh-CN: 安静的房间，陪同的家属和有权代表孩子签字的监护人在场：说明诊断、为什么现在就开始治疗、主要风险和不确定之处，取得知情同意，并用孩子能听懂的话征得他本人的同意。
dose.en: A quiet room with his relative and whoever holds parental responsibility: explain the diagnosis, why treatment starts now, the main risks and what is uncertain, take consent, and seek his own assent in words a 7-year-old understands.

response.zh-CN: 谈话已安排。本病例没有记录与家属沟通的内容；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The conversation is arranged. This case does not record what was said to the family; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 转诊儿童造血干细胞移植中心并检索供者
name.en: Refer to a paediatric transplant centre and search for a donor

dose.zh-CN: 联系儿童造血干细胞移植中心：为他做HLA配型；他没有同胞，启动非血缘供者检索。
dose.en: Contact a paediatric transplant centre: HLA-type him and, as he has no siblings, start an unrelated-donor search.

response.zh-CN: 移植团队已收到转诊，会安排HLA配型和供者检索。本病例没有记录检索何时开始；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The transplant team has the referral and will arrange HLA typing and the donor search. This case does not record when the search began; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 遗传咨询并安排父母检测
name.en: Genetic counselling with testing of both parents

dose.zh-CN: 转介遗传咨询：说明报告能说明和不能说明的内容，安排父母验证（包括母亲是否携带X连锁变异），讨论对其他亲属和今后生育的意义。
dose.en: Refer for genetic counselling: what the report does and does not show, testing of both parents (including whether his mother carries an X-linked variant), and what it means for relatives and future pregnancies.

response.zh-CN: 遗传咨询已预约。本病例没有记录遗传咨询或父母检测；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Genetic counselling is booked. This case does not record genetic counselling or parental testing; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 甲泼尼龙2 mg/kg/天静脉；疗效评估、减量和升级治疗按专科方案。
dose.en: Methylprednisolone 2 mg/kg/day IV; response, tapering and escalation per the specialist protocol.

response.zh-CN: 甲泼尼龙已开始（2 mg/kg/天是Ⅱ–Ⅳ度急性GVHD的一线剂量；治疗3天后仍进展或7天后无改善视为激素耐药）。本病例没有记录腹泻期间用了哪些药；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Methylprednisolone started (2 mg/kg/day is the first-line dose for grade II–IV acute GVHD; progression after 3 days or no improvement after 7 counts as steroid-refractory). This case does not record which drugs were used for the diarrhoea; it does not simulate their effect.

dose.zh-CN: 逐步减停全部免疫抑制剂。
dose.en: Taper and stop all his immunosuppressive drugs.

harm.zh-CN: 停用免疫抑制剂可能让急性GVHD明显加重，而不是帮助清除病毒；EBMT 2024对Ⅱ–Ⅳ度急性GVHD的做法是加用全身糖皮质激素，而不是撤除免疫抑制，HHV-6阳性本身也不是撤药的理由。
harm.en: Stopping immunosuppression can make acute GVHD much worse rather than clear the virus; EBMT (2024) treats grade II–IV acute GVHD by adding systemic steroids, not by withdrawing immunosuppression, and a positive HHV-6 result is no reason to withdraw it.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录他的免疫抑制方案或任何调整；不模拟其后果。
response.en: This case does not record his immunosuppressive regimen or any change to it; it does not simulate the consequences.

dose.zh-CN: 膦甲酸钠静脉，按体重和肾功能给药。
dose.en: Foscarnet IV, dosed by weight and renal function.

response.zh-CN: ECIL-7（2019）把膦甲酸钠或更昔洛韦用于HHV-6病（主要是脑炎）。本病例没有记录是否针对HHV-6用药；不模拟其效果。
response.en: ECIL-7 (2019) uses foscarnet or ganciclovir for HHV-6 disease, chiefly encephalitis. This case does not record whether HHV-6 was treated; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 记录每次大便的量和性状（是否带血）、腹痛和出入量。
dose.en: Record each stool's volume and appearance (any blood), abdominal pain and fluid balance.

response.zh-CN: 已开始记录；下消化道GVHD正是按粪便量分期的。本病例没有记录粪便量或分期；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Charting has started; lower-gut GVHD is staged by stool volume. This case does not record stool volumes or the stage; it does not simulate its effect.

title.zh-CN: 向家属问清这一个月的经过
title.en: Take the month's story from his relative

hint.zh-CN: 发热的经过、此前的治疗和肝脾被发现的时间，各提示了什么？家里有没有线索提示可能是遗传病？
hint.en: What do the course of the fever, the treatment so far and the timing of the enlarged organs tell you — and is there anything in the family that points to an inherited illness?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁，向陪同的家属了解病史。
guidance.en: Go to the bedside and take the history from his relative.

hint.zh-CN: 一个月发热的孩子，哪些器官的大小最能缩小鉴别范围？其他系统你会查哪些？
hint.en: In a child with a month of fever, which organs' size narrows the differential most — and which other systems will you check?

title.zh-CN: 汇总化验和骨髓结果，作出诊断
title.en: Bring the bloods and the marrow together into a diagnosis

hint.zh-CN: 哪些结果单独看都不特异，合在一起却满足一套诊断标准？EB病毒在其中扮演什么角色？
hint.en: Which results mean little alone but together meet a set of diagnostic criteria — and what part does EBV play?

guidance.zh-CN: 开出入院检查并调阅结果，在会诊板作答决策1。
guidance.en: Send the admission tests, read the results and answer decision 1 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 定下初始治疗并开始执行
title.en: Decide the first treatment and start it

hint.zh-CN: 诊断依据已经齐备，基因和功能检测却要几周——等待的代价是什么？开始用药之前，你还需要知道他的哪些数据？
hint.en: The diagnostic criteria are met, but the genetic and functional tests take weeks — what does waiting cost, and what do you need to know about him before the first dose?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策2，送出基因检测，并在床旁开始治疗。
guidance.en: Answer decision 2 on the case board, send the gene panel and start treatment at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 治疗之后：重新评估并决定下一步
title.en: After the first treatment: reassess and decide the next step

hint.zh-CN: 他的病情有了新的变化，这对下一步意味着什么？基因报告能证明什么、不能证明什么？
hint.en: What does the change in his illness mean for the plan — and what can the gene report prove, and what can it not?

guidance.zh-CN: 了解治疗后的经过，调阅病程记录和基因报告，作答决策3，并落实你的计划。
guidance.en: Ask how he has been since the treatment, read the course note and the gene report, answer decision 3 and act on your plan.

title.zh-CN: 后续病程：处理新问题并安排随访
title.en: Later course: handle the new problem and plan follow-up

hint.zh-CN: 新出现的症状可能有哪些原因，哪些发现会改变你的治疗？关于他的基因，还有什么问题没有回答，现在可以怎样回答？
hint.en: What could cause the new symptom, and which findings would change your treatment? And which question about his genes is still open — how could it be answered now?

guidance.zh-CN: 了解移植后的情况，送检并作答决策4和决策5，最后调阅转归记录。
guidance.en: Ask how he has been since the transplant, send the tests, answer decisions 4 and 5, then read the outcome record.

prompt.zh-CN: 7岁男孩间断发热约1个月，按上呼吸道感染治疗无效，肝脾肿大。血红蛋白71 g/L，血小板50×10⁹/L，白细胞3.4×10⁹/L；铁蛋白1176.6 μg/L，甘油三酯5.8 mmol/L，纤维蛋白原1.3 g/L；骨髓见噬血细胞；血EB病毒DNA 5.43×10⁷拷贝。你的工作诊断是什么？
prompt.en: A 7-year-old boy has had intermittent fever for about a month despite treatment for an upper respiratory infection, with an enlarged liver and spleen. Haemoglobin 71 g/L, platelets 50 × 10⁹/L, white cells 3.4 × 10⁹/L; ferritin 1176.6 µg/L, triglycerides 5.8 mmol/L, fibrinogen 1.3 g/L; the marrow shows haemophagocytes; blood EBV DNA 5.43 × 10⁷ copies. What is your working diagnosis?

need.zh-CN: 先问清发热经过、检查肝脾，并调阅入院时的化验、骨髓和流式细胞检查结果。
need.en: First take the fever history, examine the liver and spleen, and read the admission bloods, the marrow and the flow-cytometry result.

text.zh-CN: 噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增生症（HLH），已满足HLH-2004至少5条标准，EB病毒是可能的诱因；仍需查找原发性（遗传性）HLH和潜在的淋巴瘤
text.en: Haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis meeting at least five HLH-2004 criteria, with EBV as the likely trigger; a primary (genetic) form and an underlying lymphoma still have to be looked for

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。国际组织细胞协会的HLH-2004标准（2007）要求8条中满足5条：脾大、血红蛋白71 g/L加血小板50×10⁹/L、甘油三酯5.8 mmol/L加纤维蛋白原1.3 g/L、铁蛋白1176.6 μg/L和骨髓噬血现象已满5条；一个月的发热可能是第6条，但体温没有记录。EB病毒是最可能的诱因，但男孩的EB病毒相关HLH可能是遗传病的首次表现，也要查找淋巴瘤，所以基因和功能检测要现在就送（NACHO 2019）。
feedback.en: Right. The Histiocyte Society's HLH-2004 criteria (2007) need five of eight: splenomegaly, haemoglobin 71 g/L with platelets 50 × 10⁹/L, triglycerides 5.8 mmol/L with fibrinogen 1.3 g/L, ferritin 1176.6 µg/L and marrow haemophagocytosis already make five; the month of fever may be a sixth, but no temperature is recorded. EBV is the likeliest trigger, but EBV-HLH in a boy can be the first sign of an inherited disorder and lymphoma must be sought, so genetic and functional tests go off now (NACHO 2019).

text.zh-CN: 重症原发性EB病毒感染（传染性单核细胞增多症）：极高的病毒载量足以解释长期发热、肝脾肿大和血细胞减少，给予退热、补液等支持治疗，每周复查血常规
text.en: Severe primary EBV infection (infectious mononucleosis): the very high viral load accounts for the fever, the large liver and spleen and the low counts, so give supportive care and repeat the counts each week

feedback.zh-CN: 传染性单核细胞增多症解释不了这个组合：两系减少、纤维蛋白原1.3 g/L、甘油三酯5.8 mmol/L、铁蛋白1176.6 μg/L加骨髓噬血现象已满足HLH-2004标准（国际组织细胞协会，2007）。只做支持治疗、每周复查，会让可能致命的过度炎症得不到治疗；EB病毒相关HLH确诊后4周内开始依托泊苷者生存更好（Imashuku 2001）。
feedback.en: Infectious mononucleosis does not explain this combination: two-lineage cytopenia, fibrinogen 1.3 g/L, triglycerides 5.8 mmol/L, ferritin 1176.6 µg/L and marrow haemophagocytosis meet the HLH-2004 criteria (Histiocyte Society, 2007). Supportive care and weekly counts would leave a potentially fatal hyperinflammation untreated; in EBV-HLH, survival was better when etoposide started within four weeks of diagnosis (Imashuku 2001).

text.zh-CN: 在排除之前按急性白血病考虑：儿童发热、肝脾肿大加血细胞减少，应先复查骨髓并做免疫分型，其他诊断都放在之后再考虑
text.en: Acute leukaemia until proven otherwise: fever, an enlarged liver and spleen and low counts in a child call for a repeat marrow with immunophenotyping before any other diagnosis is considered

feedback.zh-CN: 每个HLH患儿都要查找恶性肿瘤，但这是与诊断同步进行的，不是取而代之：这份骨髓已见噬血细胞，HLH-2004标准（国际组织细胞协会，2007）已经满足。NACHO（2019）指出HLH常被延误诊断，等第二次骨髓再命名HLH会推迟治疗。
feedback.en: Malignancy is looked for in every child with HLH, but alongside the diagnosis, not instead of it: this marrow already shows haemophagocytes and the HLH-2004 criteria (Histiocyte Society, 2007) are met. NACHO (2019) warns that the diagnosis of HLH is often delayed; waiting for a second marrow before naming it delays treatment.

text.zh-CN: 细菌性脓毒症合并消耗性凝血病：纤维蛋白原和血小板降低是DIC的表现，噬血细胞只是非特异性的反应性改变，应先用广谱抗生素
text.en: Bacterial sepsis with consumptive coagulopathy: the low fibrinogen and platelets reflect DIC, the haemophagocytes are a non-specific reactive finding, and broad-spectrum antibiotics come first

feedback.zh-CN: 脓毒症可以酷似HLH，但他发热已一个月、脾大、铁蛋白1176.6 μg/L，甘油三酯5.8 mmol/L也不是DIC能解释的。这些发现合在一起满足HLH-2004标准（国际组织细胞协会，2007）；噬血细胞既非诊断所必需，也不能单独证明HLH，但在这里补全了证据链（NACHO 2019）。
feedback.en: Sepsis can mimic HLH, but he has had a month of fever with an enlarged spleen and a ferritin of 1176.6 µg/L, and triglycerides of 5.8 mmol/L are not explained by DIC. Read together, the findings meet the HLH-2004 criteria (Histiocyte Society, 2007); haemophagocytes are neither required for HLH nor proof of it on their own, but here they complete the picture (NACHO 2019).

prompt.zh-CN: 他符合HLH诊断标准，EB病毒可能是诱因；基因检测和功能检测要几周才有结果。现在怎么治疗？
prompt.en: He meets the HLH criteria, with EBV the likely trigger; the gene panel and the functional tests will take weeks. What is your treatment plan now?

text.zh-CN: 现在就开始HLH-94诱导：地塞米松10 mg/m²/天、依托泊苷150 mg/m²每周2次，加肺孢子菌预防；基因和脱颗粒检测同时送出，不等结果
text.en: Start HLH-94 induction now — dexamethasone 10 mg/m²/day and etoposide 150 mg/m² twice weekly — with Pneumocystis prophylaxis, sending the gene panel and degranulation tests without waiting for them

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。国际组织细胞协会2018年共识仍以HLH-94为依托泊苷方案的标准：地塞米松10 mg/m²/天用2周后逐步减量，依托泊苷150 mg/m²前2周每周2次、之后每周1次至第8周。EB病毒相关HLH确诊后4周内开始依托泊苷者生存更好（Imashuku 2001），所以不等基因结果；剂量按实测身高体重计算。
feedback.en: Right. The Histiocyte Society's 2018 consensus keeps HLH-94 as the standard etoposide-based therapy: dexamethasone 10 mg/m²/day for two weeks then tapered, and etoposide 150 mg/m² twice weekly for two weeks then weekly to week 8. In EBV-HLH, survival was better when etoposide started within four weeks of diagnosis (Imashuku 2001), so it does not wait for genetic results; doses use his measured height and weight.

text.zh-CN: 现在只用地塞米松10 mg/m²/天，等基因检测证实是家族性HLH再加依托泊苷，因为EB病毒诱发的继发性HLH常常靠激素和良好的支持治疗就能缓解
text.en: Start dexamethasone 10 mg/m²/day alone now and add etoposide only if the gene panel confirms a familial form, because EBV-triggered secondary HLH often settles on steroids and supportive care

feedback.zh-CN: 等基因结果会错过最关键的时间窗：EB病毒相关HLH中，确诊后4周内开始依托泊苷者长期生存率为90.2%，较晚或未用者为56.5%（Imashuku 2001）。国际组织细胞协会（2018）以HLH-94（依托泊苷加地塞米松）为依托泊苷方案的标准；2021年儿童EB病毒感染相关疾病专家共识要求一旦符合诊断标准就立即开始治疗，只有单用激素已能控制的轻症才可暂缓依托泊苷，而不是为了等基因结果。
feedback.en: Waiting for a genotype costs the window that matters: in EBV-HLH, long-term survival was 90.2 % when etoposide began within four weeks of diagnosis against 56.5 % when it began later or not at all (Imashuku 2001). The Histiocyte Society (2018) keeps HLH-94 — etoposide with dexamethasone — as the standard etoposide-based therapy, and the 2021 Chinese consensus on EBV-related disease in children starts treatment as soon as the criteria are met, deferring etoposide only while steroids alone are controlling mild disease — not to await a genotype.

text.zh-CN: 先治疗诱因：静脉更昔洛韦降低EB病毒载量，加静脉丙种球蛋白，按需输血，1周后复查铁蛋白、纤维蛋白原和血常规，再决定是否化疗
text.en: Treat the trigger first: intravenous ganciclovir for the EBV load with intravenous immunoglobulin, transfuse as needed, and repeat the ferritin, fibrinogen and blood counts in a week before any chemotherapy

feedback.zh-CN: 抗病毒药对潜伏在淋巴细胞里的EB病毒作用很小，也控制不了过度炎症；2021年儿童EB病毒感染相关疾病专家共识提醒避免过度抗病毒治疗。对已满足HLH标准的孩子观察一周，会推迟在EB病毒相关HLH中改善生存的依托泊苷（Imashuku 2001）。
feedback.en: Antivirals do little against EBV latent in lymphocytes and do not treat the hyperinflammation; the 2021 Chinese consensus on EBV-related disease in children warns against antiviral overuse. A week of observation in a child who meets the HLH criteria delays the etoposide that improved survival in EBV-HLH (Imashuku 2001).

text.zh-CN: 不做诱导，直接行异基因造血干细胞移植，因为很可能是家族性HLH，每一轮化疗都只会在根治之前徒增毒性
text.en: Go straight to allogeneic stem cell transplantation without induction, because a familial form is likely and each course of chemotherapy only adds toxicity before the definitive cure

feedback.zh-CN: 移植能根治原发性HLH，但要在诱导控制炎症之后进行：HLH-2004（国际组织细胞协会，2007）把移植留给家族性或分子确诊的HLH，以及诱导后重症持续或再活动者。HLH-94诱导先控制病情，也为找供者和等基因结果争取时间（国际组织细胞协会，2018）。
feedback.en: Transplantation cures primary HLH, but it follows induction that has controlled the inflammation: HLH-2004 (Histiocyte Society, 2007) reserves it for familial or molecularly proven HLH and for severe, persistent or reactivated disease after induction. HLH-94 induction controls the disease and buys time for the donor search and the genetic answer (Histiocyte Society, 2018).

prompt.zh-CN: 初始治疗后他一度缓解，现在病情又出现活动迹象。基因报告：UNC13D（报告写作MUNC13-4）c.1228A>C杂合变异；另有一个SH2D1A半合子变异，其核苷酸和蛋白命名排印不清。你的结论和下一步计划是什么？
prompt.en: After the first treatment he went into remission, but the disease is now showing signs of activity again. The gene report: UNC13D (MUNC13-4 in the report) c.1228A>C, heterozygous, and a hemizygous SH2D1A variant whose nucleotide and protein notation is printed unclearly. What do you conclude, and what is the plan?

need.zh-CN: 先了解他病情的最新变化，并调阅新的记录。
need.en: First find out how his illness has changed, and read the new records.

text.zh-CN: 再活动本身就是异基因移植指征：重新控制病情，启动非血缘供者检索；请实验室按HGVS重新出具两个变异并分类，做功能检测，并检测父母
text.en: Reactivation is itself an indication for transplant: regain control, search for an unrelated donor, and have both variants re-issued in HGVS, classified, functionally tested and checked in both parents

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。HLH-2004（国际组织细胞协会，2007）建议对再活动者和家族性或分子确诊者行移植，所以无论基因型如何，这次再活动已决定了移植。单个杂合变异不能确立常染色体隐性的FHL3；写法不清的SH2D1A变异要按ACMG/AMP 2015重新描述和分类后才能诊断XLP1；SAP表达和CD107a脱颗粒是功能验证（NACHO 2019），父母检测说明变异来源和携带状态。
feedback.en: Right. HLH-2004 (Histiocyte Society, 2007) recommends transplantation for reactivated disease as well as for familial or molecularly proven HLH, so the flare decides it whatever the genotype. One heterozygous variant cannot establish autosomal recessive FHL3, and an unclearly written SH2D1A variant must be re-described and classified under ACMG/AMP 2015 before it means XLP1; SAP expression and CD107a degranulation are the functional checks (NACHO 2019), and parental testing shows where each variant came from.

text.zh-CN: UNC13D变异已确诊家族性HLH 3型，基因型已经清楚：用第一个合适的供者移植即可，不需要功能检测、父母验证，也不必让实验室重新出具报告
text.en: The UNC13D variant confirms familial HLH type 3, so the genotype is settled: transplant from the first suitable donor, with no need for functional tests, parental testing or a re-issued report

feedback.zh-CN: 家族性HLH 3型是常染色体隐性遗传：只报告了一个UNC13D杂合变异、没有第二个变异，不能确立诊断；变异要按ACMG/AMP（2015）分类后才能称为致病。移植仍有指征——因为病情再活动（HLH-2004）——但省掉功能检测和父母验证，诊断、供者筛查和家庭遗传咨询都会建立在未经证实的标签上。
feedback.en: Familial HLH type 3 is autosomal recessive: one heterozygous UNC13D variant, with no second variant reported, does not establish it, and a variant is called pathogenic only after ACMG/AMP (2015) classification. Transplant is still indicated — because the disease reactivated (HLH-2004) — but skipping the functional tests and parental testing leaves the diagnosis, the donor screening and the family's counselling resting on an unproven label.

text.zh-CN: 诱因是EB病毒，家里也没人得过这种病，所以是继发性HLH：完成8周疗程后停药，只有再复发一次才考虑移植
text.en: EBV was the trigger and nobody in the family has had this illness, so it is secondary HLH: complete the 8-week course, stop treatment and consider transplantation only if the disease relapses a second time

feedback.zh-CN: 有诱因、家族史阴性都不能排除遗传性HLH；HLH-2004（国际组织细胞协会，2007）把再活动列为移植指征，2021年儿童EB病毒感染相关疾病专家共识也把复发或难治的EB病毒相关HLH作为移植的主要指征。再活动后停药，可能迎来下一次甚至致命的再活动。
feedback.en: A trigger and a negative family history do not exclude inherited HLH, and HLH-2004 (Histiocyte Society, 2007) lists reactivated disease as an indication for transplantation; the 2021 Chinese consensus on EBV-related disease in children names relapsed or refractory EBV-HLH as the main indication. Stopping treatment after a flare risks a further, possibly fatal reactivation.

text.zh-CN: SH2D1A变异已确诊X连锁淋巴组织增生症，这种病用丙种球蛋白替代和利妥昔单抗控制EB病毒即可，不需要早期异基因移植
text.en: The SH2D1A variant proves X-linked lymphoproliferative disease, which is managed with immunoglobulin replacement and rituximab to control EBV rather than with an early allogeneic transplant

feedback.zh-CN: 半合子SH2D1A变异只有在写法清楚、按ACMG/AMP（2015）分类为致病、并有SAP表达支持（NACHO 2019）时才意味着XLP1。即便确诊XLP1，它也是遗传性HLH，HLH-2004（国际组织细胞协会，2007）建议对家族性或分子确诊的HLH行移植；何况他的再活动本身就是移植指征。
feedback.en: A hemizygous SH2D1A variant means XLP1 only once it is clearly written, classified as pathogenic (ACMG/AMP 2015) and supported by SAP expression (NACHO 2019). And XLP1 is an inherited form: HLH-2004 (Histiocyte Society, 2007) recommends transplantation for familial or molecularly diagnosed HLH, and his flare is an indication in its own right.

prompt.zh-CN: 非血缘供者造血干细胞移植后，他出现腹泻，HHV-6检测阳性。你怎样处理这次腹泻？
prompt.en: After his unrelated-donor stem cell transplant he develops diarrhoea, and HHV-6 testing is positive. How do you approach the diarrhoea?

need.zh-CN: 先了解他最新的情况，并调阅相应的检查结果。
need.en: First find out how he is now, and read the relevant test result.

text.zh-CN: 同时评估急性GVHD和感染：按粪便量为肠道分期，送粪便病原学和HHV-6定量PCR，安排活检；肠道GVHD达Ⅱ度及以上即用全身糖皮质激素
text.en: Work up acute GVHD and infection together: stage the gut by stool volume, send stool pathogen tests and a quantitative HHV-6 PCR, arrange a biopsy, and start systemic steroids if gut GVHD is grade II or worse

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。异基因移植后的腹泻可能是急性GVHD、感染或两者并存，HHV-6阳性本身不能证明病毒就是病因；ECIL-7（2019）还提醒染色体整合型HHV-6会造成PCR持续阳性。肠道GVHD按粪便量分期，安全时以活检证实；Ⅱ–Ⅳ度急性GVHD一线用甲泼尼龙2 mg/kg/天，激素耐药时EBMT 2024对成人推荐芦可替尼（儿童的二线治疗由移植团队决定）。
feedback.en: Right. Diarrhoea after allogeneic transplantation may be acute GVHD, infection or both, and a positive HHV-6 result does not by itself make the virus the cause; ECIL-7 (2019) also flags chromosomally integrated HHV-6 as a source of persistently positive PCRs. Gut GVHD is staged by stool volume and confirmed by biopsy when safe; grade II–IV acute GVHD is treated first with methylprednisolone 2 mg/kg/day, and for steroid-refractory disease EBMT 2024 recommends ruxolitinib in adults (in a child the transplant team chooses the second line).

text.zh-CN: HHV-6可以解释腹泻：开始膦甲酸钠抗病毒，病毒载量下降前不用激素；抗病毒疗程结束后仍腹泻，再考虑移植物抗宿主病
text.en: HHV-6 explains the diarrhoea: start foscarnet, withhold steroids until the viral load has fallen, and reconsider graft-versus-host disease only if the diarrhoea persists after the antiviral course

feedback.zh-CN: 等病毒载量下降再用激素，可能让严重的肠道GVHD继续进展；HHV-6阳性并不排除GVHD，两者可以并存。ECIL-7（2019）把膦甲酸钠或更昔洛韦用于HHV-6病（主要是脑炎），是否抗病毒取决于有没有病毒致病的证据，而不只是检测阳性。
feedback.en: Withholding steroids from possibly severe gut GVHD while waiting for a viral load to fall can let the GVHD progress; a positive HHV-6 result does not exclude GVHD, and both can be present. ECIL-7 (2019) uses foscarnet or ganciclovir for HHV-6 disease, chiefly encephalitis, so treating rests on evidence of disease, not on a positive test alone.

text.zh-CN: 逐步减停免疫抑制剂，让新的免疫系统清除HHV-6；在此期间用口服补液、洛哌丁胺和无乳糖饮食处理腹泻
text.en: Taper and stop his immunosuppression so that the new immune system can clear HHV-6, and manage the diarrhoea meanwhile with oral rehydration, loperamide and a lactose-free diet

feedback.zh-CN: 在可能存在急性GVHD时停用免疫抑制剂，更可能加重GVHD而不是清除病毒；EBMT（2024）对Ⅱ–Ⅳ度急性GVHD的做法是加用全身糖皮质激素，而不是撤除预防用药。本病例没有记录他用的免疫抑制剂，但无论是哪种，都不应为了一个阳性病毒结果而停用。
feedback.en: Stopping immunosuppression during possible acute GVHD is more likely to make the GVHD worse than to clear the virus; EBMT (2024) treats grade II–IV acute GVHD by adding systemic steroids, not by withdrawing prophylaxis. This case does not record his immunosuppressive drugs, but whatever they are, they are not stopped to chase a positive viral test.

text.zh-CN: 按肠道移植物抗宿主病立即用甲泼尼龙2 mg/kg/天；移植后出现的HHV-6阳性只是旁观者，粪便病原学检查、肠镜活检和病毒定量都可以省去
text.en: Start methylprednisolone 2 mg/kg/day now for presumed gut graft-versus-host disease; a positive HHV-6 after a transplant is only a bystander, so the stool tests, the biopsy and the viral loads can all be skipped

feedback.zh-CN: 肠道GVHD达Ⅱ度及以上时用激素是对的（EBMT 2024），但感染仍要查：激素会加重未经治疗的感染，HHV-6阳性也不能想当然地当作旁观者（ECIL-7，2019）。粪便病原学、病毒定量和活检与治疗同步进行，而不是被省略。
feedback.en: Steroids are right if gut GVHD is grade II or worse (EBMT 2024), but infection must still be sought: steroids worsen an untreated infection, and a positive HHV-6 result is not automatically a bystander (ECIL-7, 2019). Stool pathogen tests, a quantitative viral load and biopsy run alongside treatment, not instead of it.

prompt.zh-CN: 移植后，他的遗传学诊断仍未明确。下列哪一项基因随访和家庭遗传咨询计划是正确的？
prompt.en: After the transplant his genetic diagnosis is still not settled. Which plan for his genetic follow-up and the family's counselling is right?

text.zh-CN: 用移植前保存的标本或培养的皮肤成纤维细胞检测他本人的DNA，不用移植后的血液；同时提供遗传咨询并检测父母
text.en: Test his own DNA from a sample stored before the transplant or from cultured skin fibroblasts, not post-transplant blood, and offer genetic counselling with testing of both parents

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。移植后由供者造血，血液标本测到的是供者的基因型，所以胚系检测要用移植前保存的DNA或皮肤成纤维细胞这类非血液组织。按ACMG/AMP（2015）分类时需要家系分离证据：父母检测能说明每个变异从哪里来、母亲是否携带SH2D1A变异，这关系到她的其他亲属和今后的生育。
feedback.en: Right. Once donor cells make his blood, a blood sample reports the donor's genotype, so germline testing uses DNA stored before the transplant or a non-blood tissue such as cultured skin fibroblasts. Classification under ACMG/AMP (2015) uses segregation evidence: parental testing shows where each variant came from and whether his mother carries the SH2D1A variant, which matters for her other relatives and future pregnancies.

text.zh-CN: 现在抽血复查基因：如果变异已经查不到了，说明移植已经纠正了他的基因，家里人就不需要再做遗传咨询和基因检测
text.en: Repeat the gene panel on a fresh blood sample now: if the variants are no longer found, the transplant has corrected his genes, and the family needs no further genetic counselling or testing

feedback.zh-CN: 供者细胞造血之后，血液基因检测读到的是供者的DNA：变异“消失”说明植入，不说明他的基因组被纠正，他的其他组织仍是自己的基因型。据此告诉家属不需要咨询是错误的；家庭咨询取决于他真实的基因型和父母检测，并按ACMG/AMP（2015）分类。
feedback.en: Once donor cells make his blood, a blood gene test reads the donor's DNA: losing the variants shows engraftment, not a corrected genome, and his other tissues keep his own genotype. Telling the family no counselling is needed on that basis would be wrong; their counselling depends on his true genotype and on parental testing, classified under ACMG/AMP (2015).

text.zh-CN: 改取口腔拭子：口腔细胞是他自己的，不含供者DNA，用它明确基因型以后再安排家庭遗传咨询
text.en: Take a cheek swab instead, since cells from the mouth are his own and free of donor DNA, and settle his genotype from it before arranging any counselling for the family

feedback.zh-CN: 口腔拭子里混有唾液中的白细胞，移植后可能含有供者DNA，得出混合或误导性的结果；移植前保存的DNA或培养的皮肤成纤维细胞可以避免这个问题。遗传咨询也不必等：现在就可以告诉家属已知什么、不确定什么，以及父母检测会怎样帮助判断（ACMG/AMP 2015）。
feedback.en: Cheek swabs carry white cells from saliva, so after a transplant they can contain donor DNA and give a mixed or misleading result; DNA stored before the transplant or from cultured skin fibroblasts avoids this. Counselling need not wait: the family can be told now what is known, what is uncertain and how parental testing will help (ACMG/AMP 2015).

text.zh-CN: 不需要再做检测：移植已经治愈了他，他没有兄弟姐妹，结果对他本人和家里其他人都没有影响
text.en: No further testing is needed: the transplant has cured him, he has no brothers or sisters, and a result would change nothing for him or for the rest of the family

feedback.zh-CN: 移植治疗的是他的血液和免疫系统，不改变家族的遗传风险：如果SH2D1A变异是致病的，母亲可能是携带者，她姐妹的儿子和他今后的弟弟都可能受累。变异分类和家系分离检测（ACMG/AMP 2015）正是这种咨询的基础。
feedback.en: The transplant treats his blood and immune system, not the family's genetics: if the SH2D1A variant is pathogenic, his mother may be a carrier, and her sisters' sons and any future brothers could be affected. Variant classification and segregation testing (ACMG/AMP 2015) are what make that counselling possible.

text.zh-CN: 问清发热经过、此前的治疗、肝脾被发现的时间、有无兄弟姐妹和家族史，并追问母系男性亲属和父母是否近亲
text.en: Took the fever's course, the treatment so far, when the enlarged organs were found, siblings and family history, and asked about male relatives on the mother's side and parental consanguinity

text.zh-CN: 触诊肝脏和脾脏
text.en: Palpated the liver and the spleen

text.zh-CN: 入院时调阅血常规、铁蛋白、甘油三酯、凝血、EB病毒DNA、骨髓和NK细胞流式，并送检脱颗粒功能检测
text.en: On admission read the blood count, ferritin, triglycerides, clotting, EBV DNA, marrow and NK-cell flow, and sent the degranulation assays

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即按诊断标准识别出EB病毒诱发的HLH，并保留查找遗传病因和淋巴瘤的任务
text.en: Recognised EBV-triggered HLH by its criteria at the first attempt, keeping the search for a genetic cause and lymphoma open

text.zh-CN: 骨髓结果出来后、在入院阶段就开始地塞米松和依托泊苷诱导，没有等基因结果
text.en: Started dexamethasone and etoposide induction during the admission phase, after the marrow result and without waiting for the genes

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对初始治疗方案；问过过敏史和身高体重，送出基因检测，并开始肺孢子菌预防
text.en: Chose the first-treatment plan at the first attempt; asked about allergies and his weight and height, sent the gene panel and started Pneumocystis prophylaxis

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即认识到再活动是移植指征、基因报告尚不能定论，并完成移植转诊和遗传咨询
text.en: Recognised at the first attempt that the flare indicates transplantation while the gene report is not yet conclusive, and made the transplant and genetics referrals

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即对移植后腹泻同时评估GVHD和感染：送粪便病原学并记录大便量
text.en: Worked up the post-transplant diarrhoea for GVHD and infection together at the first attempt, sending stool pathogen tests and charting the stools

text.zh-CN: 在移植后阶段、肠道GVHD分级明确后开始全身甲泼尼龙
text.en: Started systemic methylprednisolone in the post-transplant phase once the gut GVHD had been graded

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即为移植后的胚系检测选对标本，并安排家庭遗传咨询
text.en: Chose the right germline sample after the transplant and planned the family's counselling at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 避免了危险错误：按病毒感染让他出院，或在读到骨髓结果之前就用地塞米松或依托泊苷
text.en: Avoided the dangerous errors: discharging him as a viral illness, or starting dexamethasone or etoposide before the marrow result had been read

text.zh-CN: 避免了可挽回的错误：在依托泊苷之前用更昔洛韦针对EB病毒，或在移植后停用他的免疫抑制剂
text.en: Avoided the recoverable errors: ganciclovir aimed at the EBV before any etoposide, or stopping his immunosuppression after the transplant

text.zh-CN: 向家属和孩子解释诊断、治疗、基因报告的不确定性和移植计划
text.en: Explained the diagnosis, the treatment, the uncertainty in the gene report and the transplant plan to the family and the boy

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge解释与计划）：先确认陪同者与孩子的关系，以及谁有权代表孩子签署知情同意；先问家属已经知道什么、最担心什么（例如“是不是很严重的病”）；用通俗的话分块解释——“病毒把他的免疫系统激活了，停不下来，正在攻击他自己的血细胞和器官”——说明为什么这不是普通感冒、为什么现在就要用激素和化疗药依托泊苷、主要风险（感染、血细胞更低），以及为什么不等基因结果；如实说明基因报告能说明什么、不能说明什么（只有一个UNC13D变异；SH2D1A变异的写法需要实验室复核；功能检测和父母检测还没做），病情再活动后为什么建议移植、为什么要找家庭以外的供者；用7岁孩子能懂的话向他本人解释并征得他的同意；回应情绪，用回授法确认理解，约定下次谈话并记录。不要把单个变异说成确诊，不要把报告中的结局当作对他的承诺，也不要一次塞给家属太多信息。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge explanation and planning): first establishes how the companion is related to the boy and who can consent for him; asks what the family already knows and fears most ("could it be something serious?"); explains in plain chunks — "a virus has switched his immune system on and it cannot switch off, so it is attacking his own blood cells and organs" — why this is not an ordinary cold, why steroids and the chemotherapy drug etoposide start now, the main risks (infection, lower blood counts) and why treatment does not wait for the gene results; is honest about what the gene report shows and does not (one UNC13D variant; an SH2D1A variant whose notation the laboratory must review; functional and parental tests still to come) and, once the disease flares, why a transplant is advised and why the donor must come from outside the family; explains things to the boy himself in words a 7-year-old understands and seeks his assent; responds to emotion, checks understanding by teach-back, agrees when to talk again and documents it. Does not present one variant as a diagnosis, does not promise the report's outcome and does not overload the family in one sitting.

name.zh-CN: 方医生（儿童血液科上级医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童血液科上级医师，用苏格拉底式提问带教，按PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经得到的资料提问，例如：“长期发热、肝脾肿大、血细胞减少，你会怎样一步步缩小鉴别范围？”“哪些结果单独看不特异，合在一起却构成诊断？”“基因结果要几周，现在等待的代价是什么？”“用药前还缺他的哪些数据？”到了后面的阶段再问：“治疗后再活动，对下一步意味着什么？”“一个杂合变异和一个写法不清的半合子变异，分别能证明什么？”“出现腹泻又查到病毒阳性时，怎样避免只看到一个原因？”“在病程的不同阶段，用什么标本才能查到他本人的基因型？”说明这是2013年发表的历史病例：当年的检查和变异书写方式未必符合现在的规范，它的病程不能用来评价现在的治疗。不提前透露诊断、决策答案或后续病程；体温等生命体征、体重身高、肝功能、可溶性CD25、NK细胞活性、脑脊液、骨髓除噬血细胞以外的描述、所用方案和剂量、预处理和供者细节、GVHD的预防和治疗都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Paediatric haematology attending who teaches by Socratic questions and debriefs with PEARLS, asking only about what the learner already has, e.g. “With a month of fever, an enlarged liver and spleen and low counts, how will you narrow the differential step by step?”, “Which results mean little alone but together make a diagnosis?”, “The genes take weeks — what does waiting cost?”, “What do you still need to know about him before dosing?”. Later, only once the case reaches them: “What does a flare after treatment mean for the plan?”, “What can one heterozygous variant and one unclearly written hemizygous variant each prove?”, “When diarrhoea comes with a positive viral test, how do you avoid seeing only one cause?”, “Which sample shows his own genotype at each stage of his care?”. Explains that this is a historical case published in 2013: its testing and variant notation may not meet today's standards, and its course is no measure of treatment now. Never reveals the diagnosis, a decision's answer or the later course early; vital signs, weight and height, liver tests, soluble CD25, NK-cell activity, the CSF, the marrow beyond its haemophagocytes, the regimen and doses, conditioning and donor details, and GVHD prophylaxis and treatment are not recorded — never supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：7岁1个月男孩，间断发热约1个月，当地按上呼吸道感染治疗效果差；发热初期即发现肝脾肿大；家属陪同在床旁。入院的生命体征、体重和身高没有记录。可以协助建立静脉通路和采血、送检标本、联系血库和药房、按医嘱记录大便量和出入量。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容时直接说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Children's ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): boy aged 7 years 1 month with intermittent fever for about a month, little better on treatment for an upper respiratory infection elsewhere; an enlarged liver and spleen were found early in the illness; a relative is at the bedside. His admission vital signs, weight and height are not recorded. Can help with IV access and bloods, sending samples, the blood bank and pharmacy, and charting stool volumes and fluid balance when ordered. Reads orders back, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 邱医生（儿童造血干细胞移植科会诊）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童造血干细胞移植科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的结果。可以讲：HLH-2004（国际组织细胞协会，2007）的移植指征（家族性或分子确诊、诱导后重症持续或再活动）；没有同胞时的HLA配型和非血缘供者检索；遗传病患儿若用亲属供者，要先排除供者是患者或携带者；移植后腹泻的鉴别（急性GVHD、感染或两者并存），按粪便量分期和活检；Ⅱ–Ⅳ度急性GVHD一线用甲泼尼龙2 mg/kg/天，治疗3天后仍进展或7天后无改善为激素耐药，EBMT 2024对成人激素耐药推荐芦可替尼（儿童的二线治疗由移植团队决定）；HHV-6阳性的意义、染色体整合型HHV-6和ECIL-7（2019）的建议；移植后嵌合状态监测的意义。不提前给出决策答案或后续病程，不补充没有记录的结果（预处理、移植物来源、GVHD预防都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Paediatric transplant consultant who interprets only results the learner has already read. Can explain the transplant indications of HLH-2004 (Histiocyte Society, 2007: familial or molecularly proven HLH, severe persistent or reactivated disease after induction); HLA typing and the unrelated-donor search when there is no sibling; why a related donor for an inherited disorder must first be shown not to be affected or a carrier; the differential of diarrhoea after transplantation (acute GVHD, infection or both), staging by stool volume and biopsy; methylprednisolone 2 mg/kg/day first-line for grade II–IV acute GVHD, steroid-refractoriness as progression after 3 days or no improvement after 7, and ruxolitinib as EBMT 2024's recommendation for steroid-refractory disease in adults (a second line for a child is the transplant team's choice); what a positive HHV-6 result means, chromosomally integrated HHV-6 and the ECIL-7 (2019) advice; why chimerism is monitored after transplant. Never gives a decision's answer or the later course early, and adds no result the case does not record (the conditioning, graft source and GVHD prophylaxis are not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 兰医生（临床遗传科会诊）

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床遗传科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的结果。可以讲：基因名与蛋白名（UNC13D编码Munc13-4，报告写作MUNC13-4；SH2D1A编码SAP）；常染色体隐性与X连锁遗传的区别；为什么单个杂合变异不能确立隐性遗传病；变异必须按HGVS规范书写、按ACMG/AMP 2015分为致病、可能致病、意义未明、可能良性和良性五级；命名不清时要请检测实验室重新出具，读报告的人不能自行改写；穿孔素、SAP、XIAP表达和CD107a脱颗粒等功能检测怎样佐证（NACHO 2019），以及NK细胞比例为什么不等于NK细胞活性；父母验证和母亲携带者检测；遗传咨询、知情同意以及孩子能理解的同意。不提前给出决策答案或后续病程，不补充没有记录的结果。
knowledge.en: Clinical genetics consultant who interprets only results the learner has already read. Can explain gene and protein names (UNC13D encodes Munc13-4, written MUNC13-4 in the report; SH2D1A encodes SAP); autosomal recessive versus X-linked inheritance; why one heterozygous variant cannot establish a recessive disorder; that variants are written in HGVS and classified under ACMG/AMP 2015 as pathogenic, likely pathogenic, of uncertain significance, likely benign or benign; that unclear notation goes back to the testing laboratory to be re-issued, never corrected by the reader; how perforin, SAP and XIAP expression and CD107a degranulation support a diagnosis (NACHO 2019), and why an NK-cell percentage is not NK-cell activity; parental testing and maternal carrier testing; genetic counselling, consent and a child's assent. Never gives a decision's answer or the later course early, and adds no result the case does not record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：EB病毒诱发的噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增生症、未定论的基因型与移植
title.en: Debrief: EBV-triggered HLH, an unproven genotype and a transplant

conclusion.zh-CN: 孙清和，7岁1个月，间断发热约1个月，按上呼吸道感染治疗无效，肝脾肿大。血红蛋白71 g/L、血小板50×10⁹/L，铁蛋白1176.6 μg/L，甘油三酯5.8 mmol/L，纤维蛋白原1.3 g/L，骨髓见噬血细胞，满足HLH-2004诊断标准；血EB病毒DNA 5.43×10⁷拷贝提示EB病毒是诱因。基因报告只有一个UNC13D（MUNC13-4）杂合变异和一个写法不清的SH2D1A半合子变异，按本病例记录的内容，不足以证明报告标题所称的家族性HLH。按HLH方案治疗后缓解，此后又再活动，接受HLA全相合非血缘供者造血干细胞移植；移植后HHV-6阳性腹泻和临床Ⅲ度肠道GVHD经治疗好转，9个月时供者完全嵌合、无病生存、无慢性GVHD。现行做法：确诊后即开始HLH-94，不等基因结果；因再活动而移植；移植后腹泻同时评估GVHD和感染；胚系检测用移植前或非血液来源的DNA。
conclusion.en: Sun Qinghe (7 years 1 month) had about a month of fever unresolved by treatment for an upper respiratory infection, with an enlarged liver and spleen. Haemoglobin 71 g/L, platelets 50 × 10⁹/L, ferritin 1176.6 µg/L, triglycerides 5.8 mmol/L, fibrinogen 1.3 g/L and marrow haemophagocytes met the HLH-2004 criteria; blood EBV DNA of 5.43 × 10⁷ copies pointed to an EBV trigger. The gene report showed one heterozygous UNC13D (MUNC13-4) variant and an unclearly written hemizygous SH2D1A variant — as recorded, not enough to prove the familial HLH named in the report's title. He remitted on an HLH protocol, flared and had a fully HLA-matched unrelated-donor transplant; HHV-6-positive diarrhoea and clinical grade III intestinal GVHD improved with treatment, and at 9 months he had complete donor chimerism, no disease and no chronic GVHD. Today: HLH-94 without waiting for genes, transplant for the flare, GVHD and infection assessed together, germline testing on pre-transplant or non-blood DNA.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 一个月的发热和肝脾肿大，按感冒治不好，就不能再只当感染：铁蛋白、甘油三酯、纤维蛋白原和骨髓把一个不特异的表现变成了按标准成立的诊断。
keyReasoning.en: A month of fever with an enlarged liver and spleen that treatment for a cold has not settled is more than an infection: ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen and the marrow turn a non-specific picture into a diagnosis made by criteria.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: EB病毒说明的是诱因，不是易感性：男孩的EB病毒相关HLH可能是X连锁淋巴组织增生症等遗传病的首次表现，没有同胞、家族史阴性都排除不了遗传性。
keyReasoning.en: EBV explains the trigger, not the susceptibility: EBV-HLH in a boy can be the first presentation of an inherited disorder such as X-linked lymphoproliferative disease, and having no siblings and no family history excludes nothing.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 最要紧的时间节点是诱导治疗：基因和功能结果要几周，而EB病毒相关HLH的生存取决于依托泊苷开始得早不早。
keyReasoning.en: The time-critical step is induction: genetic and functional answers take weeks, while survival in EBV-HLH depended on etoposide starting early.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 决定移植的是再活动，而不是基因型；基因检查决定的是供者选择、家庭咨询和诊断标签——而本病例记录的内容并不能证实这个标签。
keyReasoning.en: The flare, not the genotype, made transplantation necessary; the genetic work-up then shapes the donor choice, the family's counselling and the label — and what this case records does not prove the label.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 移植后病毒阳性和GVHD不是二选一：两者同时查，严重的肠道GVHD不等病毒结果就治疗。
keyReasoning.en: After a transplant a positive viral test and GVHD are not alternatives: both are investigated together, and severe gut GVHD is treated without waiting for the virus to clear.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 移植后的血液基因型读的是供者：要回答他本人的胚系问题，需要移植前的DNA或非血液组织。
keyReasoning.en: A post-transplant blood genotype reads the donor: his own germline question needs pre-transplant DNA or a non-blood tissue.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是2013年发表的单例报告，不能用来比较治疗方案或估计预后。患者事实沿用1.0.0版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对；所用HLH方案和剂量、预处理、GVHD预防与治疗本病例都没有记录，病例也不模拟任何生理变化。决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点是依据现行指南的教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report published in 2013: it cannot compare treatments or set a prognosis. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article; this case does not record the HLH regimen and doses, the conditioning or the GVHD prophylaxis and treatment, and no physiology is simulated. The decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design based on current guidance and do not change the published course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征（包括发热的最高体温）、体重和身高——因此无法计算体表面积。
unknowns.en: Vital signs (including how high the fever went), weight and height — so no body-surface area can be calculated.

unknowns.zh-CN: 肝功能、乳酸脱氢酶、可溶性CD25、NK细胞活性、脑脊液和头颅影像；骨髓除噬血细胞以外的描述（增生程度、有无恶性细胞）。
unknowns.en: Liver tests, LDH, soluble CD25, NK-cell activity, CSF and brain imaging; the marrow beyond its haemophagocytes (cellularity, any malignant cells).

unknowns.zh-CN: EB病毒感染的是哪类淋巴细胞、拷贝数是每毫升血浆还是全血，以及治疗中EB病毒载量的变化。
unknowns.en: Which lymphocytes carried EBV, whether the copies were per mL of plasma or of whole blood, and how the EBV load changed on treatment.

unknowns.zh-CN: SH2D1A变异的确切写法、两个变异的致病性分类、功能检测（SAP、CD107a）和父母检测结果。
unknowns.en: The exact SH2D1A variant, the classification of both variants, functional tests (SAP, CD107a) and any parental testing.

unknowns.zh-CN: 所用HLH方案、药物、剂量和疗程；再活动的表现、时间以及移植前怎样处理。
unknowns.en: The HLH protocol, drugs, doses and duration; the signs and timing of the reactivation and how it was treated before the transplant.

unknowns.zh-CN: 预处理方案、移植物来源、供者HLA细节和GVHD预防方案。
unknowns.en: The conditioning, the graft source, the donor's HLA details and the GVHD prophylaxis.

unknowns.zh-CN: HHV-6的标本和载量、腹泻与肠道GVHD是同时还是先后出现、各器官分期、活检结果，以及使它们好转的治疗。
unknowns.en: The HHV-6 specimen and load, whether the diarrhoea and the intestinal GVHD were simultaneous or sequential, the organ stages, any biopsy and the treatment that made them better.

unknowns.zh-CN: 9个月以后的随访（“9个月”的起点也没有注明），以及中性粒细胞“0.84”的单位。
unknowns.en: Follow-up beyond 9 months (the starting point of the 9 months is not stated either), and the unit of the neutrophil figure 0.84.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 诊断：HLH-2004（国际组织细胞协会，2007）以分子诊断或8条中满足5条确诊——发热；脾大；两系及以上血细胞减少（血红蛋白<90 g/L、血小板<100×10⁹/L、中性粒细胞<1.0×10⁹/L）；空腹甘油三酯≥3.0 mmol/L和/或纤维蛋白原≤1.5 g/L；噬血现象；NK细胞活性降低或缺如；铁蛋白≥500 μg/L；可溶性CD25≥2400 U/mL。本例血红蛋白71 g/L和血小板50×10⁹/L、甘油三酯5.8 mmol/L和纤维蛋白原1.3 g/L、铁蛋白1176.6 μg/L、骨髓噬血细胞和脾大，不算发热已满5条；“NK细胞1.9%”是比例而不是活性，可溶性CD25没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Diagnosis: HLH-2004 (Histiocyte Society, 2007) needs a molecular diagnosis or five of eight criteria — fever; splenomegaly; cytopenia of ≥ 2 lineages (haemoglobin < 90 g/L, platelets < 100 × 10⁹/L, neutrophils < 1.0 × 10⁹/L); fasting triglycerides ≥ 3.0 mmol/L and/or fibrinogen ≤ 1.5 g/L; haemophagocytosis; low or absent NK-cell activity; ferritin ≥ 500 µg/L; soluble CD25 ≥ 2400 U/mL. Here haemoglobin 71 g/L with platelets 50 × 10⁹/L, triglycerides 5.8 mmol/L with fibrinogen 1.3 g/L, ferritin 1176.6 µg/L, marrow haemophagocytes and the enlarged spleen make five without counting the fever; “NK cells 1.9 %” is a proportion, not activity, and soluble CD25 is not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 诱导治疗：国际组织细胞协会2018年共识仍以HLH-94为标准——地塞米松10 mg/m²/天（第1–2周），之后5、2.5、1.25 mg/m²/天，第8周减停；依托泊苷150 mg/m²，前2周每周2次、之后每周1次至第8周；鞘注只用于中枢神经系统受累；HLH-94从第9周起加环孢素。EB病毒相关HLH中，确诊后4周内开始依托泊苷者长期生存率90.2%，较晚或未用者56.5%（Imashuku 2001）；抗病毒药不能代替（儿童EB病毒感染相关疾病专家共识，2021）。本病例只记录了HLH方案治疗和缓解，没有记录方案和剂量。
teachingPoints.en: Induction: the Histiocyte Society's 2018 consensus keeps HLH-94 as the standard — dexamethasone 10 mg/m²/day in weeks 1–2, then 5, 2.5 and 1.25 mg/m²/day, tapered off in week 8; etoposide 150 mg/m² twice weekly for 2 weeks, then weekly to week 8; intrathecal therapy only for CNS involvement; ciclosporin from week 9 in HLH-94. In EBV-HLH, long-term survival was 90.2 % when etoposide began within 4 weeks of diagnosis and 56.5 % when it began later or not at all (Imashuku 2001); antivirals do not replace it (Chinese consensus on EBV-related disease in children, 2021). This case records treatment on an HLH protocol and a remission, not the regimen or doses.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 基因解读：单个UNC13D杂合变异（c.1228A>C）不能确立常染色体隐性的FHL3，需要第二个致病变异或其他双等位缺失的证据。男孩的SH2D1A半合子变异若为致病，就是X连锁淋巴组织增生症1型（XLP1）——但前提是检测实验室按HGVS重新出具、按ACMG/AMP 2015分类、SAP表达支持，并由母亲检测说明来源（NACHO 2019列出穿孔素、SAP、XIAP表达和CD107a脱颗粒等功能检测）。2013年的报告标题称之为MUNC13-4突变家族性HLH，按现在的标准这一诊断需要两个等位基因的证据。
teachingPoints.en: Reading the genes: one heterozygous UNC13D variant (c.1228A>C) does not establish autosomal recessive FHL3, which needs a second pathogenic variant or other proof of biallelic loss. A hemizygous SH2D1A variant in a boy would mean XLP1 if pathogenic — but only once the laboratory re-issues it in HGVS, it is classified under ACMG/AMP 2015, SAP expression supports it and testing his mother shows where it came from (NACHO 2019 lists perforin, SAP and XIAP expression and CD107a degranulation as the functional assays). The 2013 report's title calls this MUNC13-4-mutated familial HLH; by today's standard that label needs both alleles.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 移植：HLH-2004把家族性或分子确诊的HLH，以及诱导后重症持续或再活动列为造血干细胞移植指征——本例由再活动决定；2021年儿童EB病毒感染相关疾病专家共识也把复发或难治的EB病毒相关HLH作为移植的主要指征。若SH2D1A变异被证实致病（XLP1，遗传性HLH），这本身也是移植指征。他没有同胞，报告记录做了HLA全相合非血缘移植；预处理和移植物来源没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Transplantation: HLH-2004 lists familial or molecularly proven HLH and severe, persistent or reactivated disease after induction as indications — the reactivation decided it here, and the 2021 Chinese consensus on EBV-related disease in children names relapsed or refractory EBV-HLH as the main indication. A proven pathogenic SH2D1A variant (XLP1, an inherited form) would be an indication in itself. He has no siblings; the report records a fully HLA-matched unrelated transplant, not the conditioning or graft source.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 移植后腹泻：可能是急性GVHD、感染或两者并存。在按粪便量分期的同时，送粪便病原学、HHV-6定量PCR并争取活检（ECIL-7，2019：注意染色体整合型HHV-6，膦甲酸钠或更昔洛韦用于HHV-6病）。Ⅱ–Ⅳ度急性GVHD一线用甲泼尼龙2 mg/kg/天；治疗3天后仍进展或7天后无改善为激素耐药，EBMT 2024对成人推荐芦可替尼；不为清除病毒而停用免疫抑制剂。报告记录HHV-6阳性腹泻和临床Ⅲ度肠道GVHD经治疗好转，所用治疗没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Diarrhoea after transplantation: acute GVHD, infection or both. Stage it by stool volume while stool pathogen tests, a quantitative HHV-6 PCR and, where safe, a biopsy run alongside (ECIL-7, 2019: think of chromosomally integrated HHV-6; foscarnet or ganciclovir for HHV-6 disease). Grade II–IV acute GVHD is treated first with methylprednisolone 2 mg/kg/day; progression after 3 days or no improvement after 7 is steroid-refractory, for which EBMT 2024 recommends ruxolitinib in adults; immunosuppression is not stopped to clear a virus. The report records HHV-6-positive diarrhoea and clinical grade III intestinal GVHD that improved with treatment, not which treatment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 胚系检测与咨询：植入后血液基因型代表供者——报告中的移植后血液检测正是如此——所以胚系确认要用移植前保存的DNA或培养的皮肤成纤维细胞等非血液组织，口腔拭子可能混有供者DNA。随后做父母检测（ACMG/AMP 2015的家系分离证据）和遗传咨询：若SH2D1A变异致病，母亲可能是携带者，她的其他男性亲属和今后的儿子都有风险。
teachingPoints.en: Germline testing and counselling: after engraftment a blood genotype is the donor's — as the report's post-transplant blood testing showed — so germline confirmation uses DNA stored before the transplant or a non-blood tissue such as cultured skin fibroblasts, and buccal swabs can carry donor DNA. Parental testing (segregation evidence under ACMG/AMP 2015) and genetic counselling follow: if the SH2D1A variant is pathogenic, his mother may be a carrier, with risk for her other male relatives and future sons.

notice.en: A teaching-script measure, not a validated competency score.

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征（包括发热的最高体温）、体重和身高——因此无法计算体表面积。
unknowns.en: Vital signs (including how high the fever went), weight and height — so no body-surface area can be calculated.

unknowns.zh-CN: 肝功能、乳酸脱氢酶、可溶性CD25、NK细胞活性、脑脊液和头颅影像；骨髓除噬血细胞以外的描述（增生程度、有无恶性细胞）。
unknowns.en: Liver tests, LDH, soluble CD25, NK-cell activity, CSF and brain imaging; the marrow beyond its haemophagocytes (cellularity, any malignant cells).

unknowns.zh-CN: EB病毒感染的是哪类淋巴细胞、拷贝数是每毫升血浆还是全血，以及治疗中EB病毒载量的变化。
unknowns.en: Which lymphocytes carried EBV, whether the copies were per mL of plasma or of whole blood, and how the EBV load changed on treatment.

unknowns.zh-CN: SH2D1A变异的确切写法、两个变异的致病性分类、功能检测（SAP、CD107a）和父母检测结果。
unknowns.en: The exact SH2D1A variant, the classification of both variants, functional tests (SAP, CD107a) and any parental testing.

unknowns.zh-CN: 所用HLH方案、药物、剂量和疗程；再活动的表现、时间以及移植前怎样处理。
unknowns.en: The HLH protocol, drugs, doses and duration; the signs and timing of the reactivation and how it was treated before the transplant.

unknowns.zh-CN: 预处理方案、移植物来源、供者HLA细节和GVHD预防方案。
unknowns.en: The conditioning, the graft source, the donor's HLA details and the GVHD prophylaxis.

unknowns.zh-CN: HHV-6的标本和载量、腹泻与肠道GVHD是同时还是先后出现、各器官分期、活检结果，以及使它们好转的治疗。
unknowns.en: The HHV-6 specimen and load, whether the diarrhoea and the intestinal GVHD were simultaneous or sequential, the organ stages, any biopsy and the treatment that made them better.

unknowns.zh-CN: 9个月以后的随访（“9个月”的起点也没有注明），以及中性粒细胞“0.84”的单位。
unknowns.en: Follow-up beyond 9 months (the starting point of the 9 months is not stated either), and the unit of the neutrophil figure 0.84.
